description: Sync POS receipts, customers, products, and inventory.

loyverse_new_category_trigger.description: Runs for each new category in Loyverse. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, color, created_at, deleted_at

loyverse_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer in Loyverse. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, email, phone_number, address, city, region, postal_code, country_code, customer_code, note, first_visit, last_visit, total_visits, total_spent, total_points, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, permanent_deletion_at

loyverse_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs for each new employee in Loyverse. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, email, phone_number, stores, is_owner, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

loyverse_new_item_trigger.description: Runs for each new item in Loyverse. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, handle, item_name, description, reference_id, category_id, track_stock, sold_by_weight, is_composite, use_production, components, primary_supplier_id, tax_ids, modifiers_ids, form, color, image_url, option1_name, option2_name, option3_name, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, variants
